I came to Mason completely burned out and burned through my budget by other “ad experts” who overpromised, underdelivered, and disappeared the second things got tough. I was skeptical. I was guarded. I almost didn’t reach out.
I’m so glad I did.

From day one, Mason was different. No smoke and mirrors, no wild guarantees, no pressure tactics. He sat down with me, actually listened, asked the right questions, and laid out a realistic game plan. That alone was refreshing. But then he actually executed on it.
By month two, I was sitting at a 40x ROAS. Let that sink in. Forty times return on ad spend. Numbers I genuinely didn’t think were possible for my business. I’ve had agencies throw spaghetti at the wall and call it a “strategy” …Mason runs a tight, intentional operation, and the results speak for themselves.
What sets him apart just as much as the results is the communication. I am in constant contact with Mason. He’s responsive, proactive, and never leaves me wondering what’s happening with my campaigns. If something changes, he tells me. If there’s an opportunity, he’s already on it. I don’t chase him down…..he’s already there. That kind of reliability is genuinely rare in this space.
He’s also refreshingly realistic and grounded. He won’t tell you what you want to hear just to close a deal. He’ll tell you what you need to hear to actually grow. There’s no upsell pressure, no inflated ego, just a guy who is genuinely great at what he does and cares about his clients’ success.
If you’ve been burned before like I have, I completely understand the hesitation. But Mason is the real deal. Trust the process, trust the guy, and get ready to see your Meta ads actually work.
Highest possible recommendation

text.text:
I engaged EZ Marketing Agency with high hopes, investing both trust and a significant financial commitment. From the outset, I clearly communicated that my primary objective was lead generation for my Yoga Teacher Training (YTT) in June 2025. Unfortunately, after four months and a $6,000 AUD investment, I received no tangible results—no leads, no meaningful improvement in organic traffic, and no noticeable SEO progress.

While the team was polite, the execution fell far short of expectations. The keyword strategy was flawed from the start, initially confusing my business with another yoga school in India. Website updates were slow, and key deliverables were delayed or poorly executed. Despite multiple follow-ups, I saw no substantive action on YouTube SEO, which was part of the agreed scope. The only concrete result was a logo, which required revisions that were never completed.

Marketing is a results-driven industry, and I saw no return on my investment. While I understand that SEO takes time, the complete lack of measurable progress over four months was deeply disappointing. I would not recommend this agency to anyone seeking serious growth or lead generation.
